QuestInfo.name: Grendel the Possibly Useful
QuestInfo.0: You've found Athena Pierce. See if she is willing to help us with our cause.
QuestInfo.1: Athena Pierce seemed skeptical about the whole inter-dimensional teleportation thing, but she's offered to help. Find Grendel the Really Old in Ellinia. He'll be the old guy.
QuestInfo.2: You found Grendel the Really Old in Ellinia. The books in his library weren't of much help.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 3,201\nCan proceed to the Touch of Chaos

npc.0: Talk to Grendel the Really Old in the Ellinia Magic Library. You can take the Regular Taxi to get there quickly.
